{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 1:15). Only Sofia and Jack spoke; I saw and heard nothing from Omar or Hana, so I have no basis to rate them yet. I need to watch or ask on the next visit.

SOFIA: Drew the fish plan on the pad (top line = stroke 1, bottom = stroke 2, tail flares at right). She said she'd take a tray of dominoes and start from the nose. She also corrected the split: whoever traces stroke 1 lays the start domino, so she takes the top line and Jack takes the bottom. She proposed checking tail ends and joins once both lines are done. That is good planning, clear communication and early leadership. The table shows a connected chain from the start running up and right, which is probably her stroke 1. I didn't see her place the dominoes and don't know who did, so I'm treating that as likely rather than confirmed. The chain is only partway along the top line at 1:15.

JACK: Fetched 40 dominoes for the bin, which is a useful supply role. He first claimed the top line, then Sofia reassigned him to the bottom line. He hasn't acknowledged the swap yet. Nothing on the table is clearly his, and I haven't seen him place any. Check that he started stroke 2 and that the swap didn't cause confusion.

OMAR: No observations.

HANA: No observations.

FOLLOW-UP: Ask Omar and Hana what they're working on. Look at the stroke 2 progress and the joins at the tail. Don't credit anyone for the visible chain without confirming."}
